Definition: Ozni, an Israelite; also an Oznite (collectively), his descendant
BiblicalUsage: Ozni was a son of Gad, named once in the census of the tribes in the wilderness, as the head of the family of the Oznites. His family went down into Egypt with Jacob, and came up again with Moses.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ozni is one of the sons of Gad, and his name in the census shows that God counted every family that went into Egypt.
